scientific_integrity.claim: Sharp dimension-normalized L-infinity norm, uniform radial profile, and center/boundary maximizing-radius transition at alpha=-1/2.
limitations: No exact finite-dimension global maximum or finite-dimension location theorem.
No joint limit with varying weight exponent and no extension to polynomial degrees other than two.
Bibliographic priority requires independent review; equivalent Christoffel-Lebesgue formulations may exist.
scientific_integrity.method: Normalized quadratic reproducing kernel, Beta-Gamma and Gaussian coupling, strict Gamma absolute-deviation comparison.
scientific_integrity.scope: Fixed weight exponent alpha>-1, polynomial degree two, real d-dimensional Euclidean unit balls; d tends to infinity. Orthogonal L2 projector acting on bounded real or complex functions.

title: A radial-to-boundary phase transition for quadratic projection on weighted balls
